verses.text: This is the family history of Aaron and Moses at the time the LORD spoke with Moses on Mount Sinai.
These are the names of Aaron's sons: Nadab the oldest, then Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
These were Aaron's sons, the priests who were anointed and set apart to serve as priests.

But Nadab and Abihu died in front of the LORD when they offered him a fire that was not allowed, in the Sinai desert. They had no children. So Eleazar and Ithamar served as priests while their father Aaron was alive.
The LORD said to Moses,
"Bring the tribe of Levi forward and put them under Aaron the priest to help him.
They will do the work for him and for the whole community at the Tent of Meeting, serving at the Holy Tent.
They will take care of all the furniture of the Tent of Meeting and do the work the people of Israel are responsible for, serving at the Holy Tent.
Give the Levites to Aaron and his sons. From all the people of Israel, they are the ones given completely to him.
Appoint Aaron and his sons to serve as priests. Anyone else who comes near the holy things must be put to death."
The LORD said to Moses,
"Look, I have chosen the Levites from among the people of Israel to take the place of every firstborn son of Israel. The Levites belong to me,
because all the firstborn are mine. On the day I struck down all the firstborn in Egypt, I set apart for myself every firstborn in Israel, both people and animals. They are mine. I am the LORD."
The LORD spoke to Moses in the Sinai desert. He said,
"Count the Levites by their families and clans. Count every male one month old or more."
So Moses counted them, as the LORD had told him.
These were the sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
These were the clans from the sons of Gershon: Libni and Shimei.
The clans from the sons of Kohath were Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
The clans from the sons of Merari were Mahli and Mushi. These were the clans of the Levites, by their families.
The clans of Libni and Shimei came from Gershon. These were the Gershonite clans.
The number of all their males one month old or more was seven thousand five hundred.
The Gershonite clans were to camp on the west side, behind the Holy Tent.
The leader of the Gershonite families was Eliasaph son of Lael.
At the Tent of Meeting, the Gershonites were in charge of the Holy Tent itself, its tent and covering, the curtain at the door of the Tent of Meeting,
the curtains of the courtyard, the curtain at the entrance to the courtyard around the Holy Tent and the altar, and the ropes. They did all the work connected with these things.
The clans of Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel came from Kohath. These were the Kohathite clans.
The number of all their males one month old or more was eight thousand six hundred. They were in charge of the holy place.
The Kohathite clans were to camp on the south side of the Holy Tent.
The leader of the Kohathite families was Elizaphan son of Uzziel.
They were in charge of the Covenant Box, the table, the lampstand, the altars, the tools used in the holy place, and the curtain. They did all the work connected with these things.
The chief leader of the Levites was Eleazar, son of Aaron the priest. He was in charge of those who took care of the holy place.
The clans of Mahli and Mushi came from Merari. These were the Merarite clans.
The number of all their males one month old or more was six thousand two hundred.
The leader of the Merarite families was Zuriel son of Abihail. They were to camp on the north side of the Holy Tent.
The Merarites were in charge of the frames of the Holy Tent, its crossbars, posts, bases, and all its equipment. They did all the work connected with these things,
and also with the posts all around the courtyard, with their bases, tent pegs, and ropes.

Moses, Aaron, and Aaron's sons were to camp on the east side of the Holy Tent, in front of the Tent of Meeting, toward the sunrise. They were in charge of the holy place on behalf of the people of Israel. Anyone else who came near it was to be put to death.
The total number of Levite males one month old or more, counted by Moses and Aaron by their clans at the LORD's command, was twenty-two thousand.
The LORD said to Moses, "Count all the firstborn males of Israel who are one month old or more, and make a list of their names.
Take the Levites for me in place of all the firstborn sons of Israel, and the Levites' animals in place of all the firstborn animals of the people of Israel. I am the LORD."
So Moses counted all the firstborn sons of Israel, as the LORD had commanded him.
The total number of firstborn males one month old or more, listed by name, was twenty-two thousand two hundred seventy-three.
The LORD said to Moses,
"Take the Levites in place of all the firstborn sons of Israel, and the Levites' animals in place of their animals. The Levites belong to me. I am the LORD.
There are two hundred seventy-three more firstborn sons of Israel than there are Levites. To buy them back,
collect five pieces of silver for each one, using the official weight of the holy place, which is twenty small weights to each piece.
Give the money paid to buy back the extra firstborn to Aaron and his sons."
So Moses collected the money from the firstborn who were more than the number of Levites who took their place.
From the firstborn of Israel he collected one thousand three hundred sixty-five pieces of silver, using the official weight of the holy place.
Moses gave the money to Aaron and his sons, as the LORD had commanded him.
